title: AI ALIGNMENT THROUGH REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FROM HUMAN FEEDBACK? CONTRADICTIONS AND LIMITATIONS
findings: The paper does not analyze or discuss religion, faith, or specific religious groups. Its focus is on a broader sociotechnical critique of AI alignment methods like RLHF.
